name: sidecar-wake-internet
description: Wake Island co-op as a passworded internet server (serverInternet 1), so a join goes through the real CD-key path instead of the LAN accept: GameSpyHost::authenticateUser only short-circuits for the game id "lan". gcd_authenticate_user (lnxded 0x0810d380) rejects a response shorter than 72 characters or a key hash already on the server, then asks key.gamespy.com:29910; with no answer after three 2 s tries gcd_think accepts (features/udp-sidecar/wire.md section 4). The server heartbeats the community master (master.bf1942.org), so it is listed publicly; the password keeps it private.
human: No client needed: `node sidecar/join.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 --password cdkeytest` joins through the CD-key check. The game client joins with the `join:` line `start` prints (+isInternet 1 +password cdkeytest). `lab.py status` lists players; `lab.py stop` collects the event log.
